بيانفي إطار التزامه بمسؤوليته الاجتماعية: As part of its commitment to social responsibility, Mobilis is offering free calls and SMS to all networks, along with unlimited internet, to its subscribers in areas affected by wildfires for a period of one week. This initiative comes in solidarity with the affected citizens to enable them to stay in touch with their loved ones. It also falls within the framework of supporting national efforts and aligning with the directives of the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications to support those affected. The concerned subscribers will receive SMS notifications informing them of the availability of the free service in their areas starting this evening, once the technical procedures for each region are completed. Together, we build the future.
